name: PUDU Robotics

ownership.summary: Reviewed official materials identify Shenzhen Pudu Technology Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries and affiliates as the company scope behind PUDU products and services. They describe multiple financing rounds but do not disclose a parent company or a complete current control table, so investment history is not treated as proof of parent ownership.

productPortfolio.name: CC1 and CC1 Pro autonomous cleaning robots
productPortfolio.positioning: Four-in-one commercial floorcare platforms combining sweeping, scrubbing, vacuuming and dust mopping with navigation, reporting and optional docking.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Validate floor coverage, edge performance, water handling, dock requirements, elevator integration and acceptance metrics at the actual site.

productPortfolio.name: MT1 cleaning-robot family
productPortfolio.positioning: AI-enabled sweepers and vacuum variants for large commercial, industrial and mixed indoor or semi-outdoor environments.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Match debris type, surface, aisle clearance, weather limits, filtration, runtime and charging strategy to the duty cycle.

productPortfolio.name: PUDU Link and fleet services
productPortfolio.positioning: Software supports robot status, task management, operational reporting and connected multi-site deployments.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Document subscription, hosting region, user access, cybersecurity, retention, update and offboarding terms.

productPortfolio.name: Delivery, industrial and embodied-AI robots
productPortfolio.positioning: The wider company portfolio spans service delivery, industrial delivery and general embodied-AI products beyond cleaning.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Do not assume that a regional partner accredited for one PUDU product line can supply and support every other line.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: PUDU's current company page reports three factories in Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Jiangxi.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm the producing entity, factory, serial range and country of origin for the ordered model instead of assigning every robot to the group network.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The company page describes proprietary research across navigation, multi-robot scheduling, motion control and integrated robot modules.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Request the applicable safety, radio, cybersecurity and product-compliance documents for the destination market.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Official CC1 Pro and MT1 pages define different cleaning modes, sensors, capacities, accessories and docking requirements.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Freeze the exact model, hardware revision, dock, consumables, software package and optional accessories in the purchase order.

marketsChannels.evidence: PUDU reports a global network of overseas subsidiaries and hundreds of service centers across dozens of countries and regions.
marketsChannels.scope: Company-reported global distribution and service footprint
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the authorized local seller and the service center that will hold parts and meet response-time commitments for the site.

marketsChannels.evidence: PUDU markets cleaning robots to retail, hospitality, healthcare, transport, education, manufacturing and property-service environments.
marketsChannels.scope: Target applications, not guaranteed site performance
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Run a representative pilot and record measurable acceptance criteria for traffic, surfaces, obstacles, edges and operator intervention.

marketsChannels.evidence: PUDU's privacy policy applies to PUDU Link and related platforms offered by the named company and its affiliates.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Have IT and legal teams verify the contracting entity, data locations, sub-processors, access controls, retention and deletion process.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: PUDU brings commercial-cleaning products into a broad service-robot platform with a large reported deployment and service footprint. Buyer value depends on system execution rather than the robot alone: site fit, docking, networking, data terms, local technician capacity and software continuity should be contracted together.
